messages:
mike_h: quick heads-up — planning a nightcap unpin of runtime v3.2 in eu-west tomorrow 00:30 UTC. this is to lift a soft pin held for the kv-cache regression. i want a short rollback playbook + SDK compatibility checklist before we proceed.

deploy-bot: scheduled: runtime-unpin eu-west v3.2 at 2024-09-04T00:30:00Z (ET = nightshift). autoretries=3, fallback-route=runtime-v3.1. pinlist updated.

sara_k: thanks. two quick asks: 1) can we ensure sdk-4.0 clients with new signing header don't get routed to v3.1 fallback? 2) confirm embeddings infra has no version lock that breaks older kv-cache format.

anya: +1 on sara's point. i ran a smoke test this morning — inference path looks fine for generation, but embeddings response schema changed in sdk-4.0 (field names). if fallback hits v3.1 clients might see missing fields.

mike_h: good call. proposal: add a temporary routing rule for requests with header x-sdk-version>=4 to prefer runtime-v3.2 variant; fallback only for non-sdk requests. that reduces exposure while we unpin. thoughts?

todd_r: that works. ops note: adding header-based routing requires a quick deploy to the router service (non-disruptive). i can push a config change and monitor 15m before unpin.

priya_ops: i'll stand up a canary fleet in eu-west with 2 nodes on v3.2 and 2 nodes on v3.1 to validate traffic split. metric watchlist: 95p latency, error-rate, embedding-schema-errors, kv-cache-miss-rate.

anya: also add a small prompt set regression check — a handful of embed+completion prompts that exercise long-prefix kv-cache. we saw divergence last time after longseq.

sara_k: regarding rollback playbook: if we hit >1.5% error-rate or any schema regressions for embeddings, we rollback by restoring the pin (runtime=v3.1 only) and enable immediate re-route to v3.1. deploy-bot can handle pin restore, but we need a comms line and feature-flag flip.

mike_h: agreed. i'll draft a 3-step rollback doc in /handbook/releases (short) and tag #oncall. steps: 1) lock deploybot pinlist, 2) flip router rule to hard route to v3.1, 3) notify customers via status page if impact > 5%.

todd_r: i'll prepare the router patch and a fast revert. deploy-bot will emit a webhook on success/failure so we can track.

priya_ops: scheduling: router patch -> canary fleet validation (30m) -> unpin rollout (gradual 10/30/60% over 45m) -> full. i'll own the rollout and metrics.

deploy-bot: note: pinned runtime list updated by mike_h to include temporary rule for sdk>=4.0. to restore pin use: `deploybot pin runtime eu-west v3.1 --reason "rollback-nightcap"`.

mike_h: perfect. final asks before we go: sara/anya confirm SDK signing/hdr check done, todd confirm router patch ready, priya confirm oncall + canary window. if all green i'll trigger the router patch tomorrow 23:45 UTC and start canary at 00:10 UTC.

sara_k: i'll validate signing header mapping and post results in this thread by EOD.

anya: i'll run the prompt regression set and paste the diffs in here.

todd_r: patch ready, tested on staging. will push at 23:45 and roll back if errors in deploy stream.

priya_ops: oncall scheduled (me + ops-02), canary dashboard created, alerting runbook linked.

mike_h: thanks team. if nothing critical shows up i'll proceed with the plan. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: thread closed for scheduling; react with :rocket: to opt-in for watch.
